0.1 Metadata

0.1.1 Description

Dataset name: Dataset containing freesort minus causal pairs scores from Study 1, to be used for selecting items for Study 2

This data set was generated by the experiment1_analysis.Rmd script. There are 210 rows, corresponding to the 210 possible item pairs. There are 7 columns containing the items (first item in the pair, second item in the pair), their domains, item-pair-averaged freesort and causal distances, and the freesort minud causal distance. The latter is the measure used to select items for study 2.
